text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency spike on /v1/generate (prod-us-west). 2.6s over 5m window, SLO p99=1.0s. PagerDuty triggered.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-5421 fired to schedule 'eng-oncall' (sev: high). Escalation policy: oncall -> sr_sre.

oncall-alex: ACK. I'm on it. Bringing up consoles now. Please post any quick mitigation ideas.

maria-ml: Looking at model side: no obvious model OOMs in the last 10m. KV cache evictions are high for us-west replicas, eviction rate ~12k/min. Could be hot-key / cache thrash.

ryan-platform: Autoscaler shows surge in concurrent requests to the runtime pool level 3 -> 7. New nodes are provisioning but warmup latency is ~30s, so tail effects. Also seeing GPU mem pressure on sidecars.

sre-jess: Quick mitigation checklist: 1) throttle heavy callers (rate-limit top API keys) 2) route new traffic to eu-west as fallback 3) disable large-batch inference path (temporary) 4) bump min replicas on critical pool.

oncall-alex: Doing #1 now - applying rate limit rule for top 5 keys (heavy-tenant-*). Command: ```/infra-run rate-limit add --key-prefix heavy-tenant- --qps 10 --window 60s```

oncall-alex: Also triggering a canary reroute: shifting 20% of prod-us-west traffic to eu-west model variant. Using routing rule id rf-2026-tilt.

maria-ml: Based on traces, KV cache misses correlate with requests that include long prefixes (long context). Suggest enabling prefix caching for recent prefixes for 5m to reduce recompute. Can do config flip.

ryan-platform: I can bump min replicas for pool rn: ```infra scale set --pool gen-prod-usw --min 6```. Will do if ack. Note: could increase cost but reduces coldstart tail.

eng-lead-kai: Do the minimum set: rate-limit + bump min replicas + reroute. Keep rollback plan: revert rate-limit and reroute after stabilization. Notify CS if any customer sees degraded throughput.

oncall-alex: Done rate-limit and started scale command. Autoscaler shows desired=6, current=4, pending start. Reroute 20% applied.

sre-jess: Added temporary autoscaler override to avoid aggressive downscale while warmup settles: ```autoscaler override --pool gen-prod-usw --ttl 10m --min 6```.

cs-emma: I pinged top customers in US-West tier A just in case. No reports yet but CS standing by.

maria-ml: Applied prefix cache config flip (ttl 5m) to gen-hot path. Monitoring cache hit rate.

ryan-platform: New nodes are up, sidecar mem pressure reduced. p99 just dropped to 1.4s (from 2.6s) in the next minute. Still above SLO but trending down.

oncall-alex: Marking timeline: 1798504321 alert -> 1798504460 mitigations applied (rate-limit, reroute, scale), 1798504560 cache flip.

sre-jess: If p99 doesn't hit <1.0s in 10m, escalate to infra-inc and consider temporary model-quantization fallback.

eng-lead-kai: Agreed. Keep watch. Assigning follow-up owner: maria-ml to validate root cause and create post-incident eval.

maria-ml: On it. I'll collect eval prompts and perf diffs, and open a postmortem ticket. Early hypothesis: cache thrash combined with slow node warmup + bursty long-context requests.

oncall-alex: p99 now 0.95s. Declaring active mitigation successful. Will keep autoscaler override for 10m then revisit.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-5421 acknowledged by oncall-alex. Status: acknowledged -> monitoring.

sre-jess: Great job. Next steps: maria to write blameless postmortem, ryam (ryan) to adjust scaling warmup profile, kai to review routing fallback policy to make cross-region tilt smoother.

oncall-alex: Handing off to night oncall at 1798504645. I leave notes in the incident ticket. Closing thread here. :white_check_mark:
